name: 右上完了と大見出しの設定ヘッダー
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0005 右上完了と大見出しの設定ヘッダー.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render exactly ONE settings header with a right-top completion action and a separate left-aligned title below. Original region x16,y82,w358,h94 normalized. Only text: 完了 at upper right, 設定 at lower left. Preserve source's distinct vertical hierarchy and generous but compact gap; do not center the title or put it on the same baseline as the action. Locked typography: 設定 Meiryo Bold20px/28px, 完了 Meiryo Regular14px/24px, tracking0, enlarged uniformly from logical358px width. Pure-white canvas/surface, no enclosing card, no phone chrome, no settings rows, icons or extra content. Adapt original blue Done to a compact forest-green gradient completion pill with white label and restrained soft shadow at top-right; retain original alignment and relative proportions. Main title ink#1D1D1D. Wide readable composition around1536x600, restrained margin, source crop and Japanese mock guide only this two-element header.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; white rounded cards, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Adapt completion emphasis to forest-green gradient; no other state or group exists in header so no added accent. Dark original surface becomes binding official pure white.
reviewNotes: 原画面全体とcrop、保存mock、native文字設定を確認。原版の右上Done強調を森緑の完了へ適応、下段左の設定見出しを保持。生成後に日本語2要素、右上/左下の関係、白canvas、追加cardや行がないことを目視。文字階層は保持する候補だが生成bitmapの厳密font/寸法一致は保証しない。操作/native編集/所有者承認は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
